messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['Please submit the tax refund request and allow us in order to process it.', "nous Avon determine Que vows TES admissible reservoir un reimbursement d'un Montana de 412.00", 'Your Card was used to buy a $200 Gift Card on a computer or device that had not been previously associated with that Amazon account on July 2, 2016 at4:42:11 PM (GMT)', 'I am here-by seeking your service in helping me receive a large amount of money and in giving clear research and feasibility studies on areas I could invest on.', 'CURRENT STATUS: PAYMENT PENDING...', 'After this term, the required amount will be taken from your Apple ID and the atonement will be put on.', 'Thus, we are seeking your unwavering assistance that the remaining amount of US$22M can be speedily processed and fully remitted into your nominated bank account.', 'I will map out 20% for you.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by Apple to inform you that we were unable to process your last payment of bill.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
